s1.syndrome_frame: Acute febrile illness with respiratory and cutaneous manifestations
salient_findings: Painful ecchymotic lesions with hemorrhagic bullae
Multifocal alveolar infiltrates on chest radiography and CT
Thrombotic paucicellular vasculopathy on skin biopsy
key_facts: Intermittent night sweats for several months
Arthralgias of the wrists and ankles
Multiple painful ecchymoses with hemorrhagic bullae
Elevated lactate dehydrogenase and erythrocyte sedimentation rate
Positive FilmArray respiratory panel for respiratory syncytial virus

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute febrile illness with respiratory and cutaneous manifestations
salient_findings: Painful ecchymotic lesions with hemorrhagic bullae
Multifocal alveolar infiltrates on chest radiography and CT
Thrombotic paucicellular vasculopathy on skin biopsy
key_facts: Intermittent night sweats for several months
Arthralgias of the wrists and ankles
Multiple painful ecchymoses with hemorrhagic bullae
Elevated lactate dehydrogenase and erythrocyte sedimentation rate
Positive FilmArray respiratory panel for respiratory syncytial virus

differentials: Atypical pneumonia due to Mycoplasma pneumoniae
per_call: Atypical pneumonia due to Mycoplasma pneumoniae

shortlist.label: Antiphospholipid syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Positive lupus anticoagulant, anticardiolipin IgM, and anti-phosphatidylserine IgM

shortlist.label: Leukocytoclastic vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Skin biopsy showing superficial and deep dermal thrombotic paucicellular vasculopathy

shortlist.label: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
shortlist.why_kept: Respiratory and renal involvement, elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate

shortlist.label: Eosinophilic granuloma with polyangiitis
shortlist.why_kept: Respiratory symptoms, elevated lactate dehydrogenase, and eosinophilic pneumonia possibility

shortlist.label: Henoch-Schönlein purpura
shortlist.why_kept: Palpable purpura, arthralgias, and abdominal involvement

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with fever, weight loss, and multiple painful ecchymoses with hemorrhagic bullae, along with laboratory findings of thrombotic paucicellular vasculopathy and positive tests for lupus anticoagulant, anticardiolipin IgM, and anti-phosphatidylserine IgM, are consistent with antiphospholipid syndrome.

rejected.label: Leukocytoclastic vasculitis
rejected.why: The biopsy showed paucicellular vasculopathy without significant neutrophils or leukocytoclasia, which is not typical of leukocytoclastic vasculitis.

rejected.label: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
rejected.why: The patient's presentation and laboratory findings do not suggest granulomatous inflammation or the presence of anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies, which are characteristic of granulomatosis with polyangiitis.

rejected.label: Eosinophilic granuloma with polyangiitis
rejected.why: There is no evidence of eosinophilia or granulomatous inflammation in the patient's presentation or laboratory findings, making this diagnosis unlikely.

rejected.label: Henoch-Schönlein purpura
rejected.why: The patient's age and the presence of systemic symptoms such as fever, weight loss, and arthralgias, as well as the laboratory findings, are not typical of Henoch-Schönlein purpura, which is more commonly seen in children and young adults with palpable purpura and abdominal pain.
